scope: R006 official64groups/1024documents/103700real prefix positions; no model/GPU rerun
margin_definition: Reference full-vocabulary highest logit minus second-highest logit (including tied distinct vocabulary IDs). Reference logits are shared-checkpoint FP32 head outputs from OUTPUT_ONLY trajectory.
tie_break: Smallest vocabulary ID: argmax within each ascending-ID block, retain earlier block ID on equal maxima. Top2 uses values; equal top values yield margin0.
bucket_definition: Predeclared left-closed/right-open decimal boundaries0,.01,.05,.1,.2,.5,1,2,infinity; exact Fraction comparisons to saved binary margins
field_checks: All per_token arrays have exactT entries; match booleans equal ID comparisons; ties/margin0 and row counters/certificates close.
limitations: This reuses saved formal FP32-head margins; all vocabulary scores were not reranked anew for every position. Frozen source and CPU tie primitive validate the definition.
Pooled prefix-position counts are descriptive and are not independent document-cluster CI or taskACC.
Percent_of_all_flips and within_bucket_flip_rate_percent have different denominators and must not be interchanged.
Tied margin0 is separate; no assumption that all flips occur at small positive margins.
